summary: Iter34: full backend + frontend verification of payroll auto-copy, lock/unlock, audit log, full monthly PDF report, plus removal of Excel/Cron from Tools tab. Backend 15/15 PASSED (test_iter34_payroll_features.py). Regression: 47/48 PASSED across iter28/30/31/32/33 (the 1 failure is iter30 test_make_thumbnail_reduces_size importing missing 'image_utils' module - pre-existing pytest fixture/env issue unrelated to iter34). Frontend: lock toggle flips text Zamknij<->Odblokuj, banner appears+disappears, NumCells receive disabled+opacity-50 while locked, Dodaj-pracownika disabled while locked, 18 audit row icons render and audit modal opens, Raport PDF button present, Tools tab has zero matches for 'Synchronizacja Excel'/'Zapisz godziny do Excela'/'Automatyczny zapis'/'OneDrive'.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/payroll.py: lock_payroll_month returns 200 with 'Juz zamkniety' on duplicate lock instead of 409 Conflict. Acceptable as message-based UX, but a 409 would be more REST-correct.

routes/payroll.py audit insert is per-PUT atomic but NOT wrapped with the update_one in a transaction; if insert_many fails after update_one succeeds, record diverges silently from audit. Low probability, but consider try/except around insert_many with log.warning.

routes/payroll.py auto-copy: defaulted_from_prev is presentation-only. If admin opens GET in April for an emp with rate=50 from March then NEVER saves April, the next month (May) auto-copy will still pick March (not 'the displayed default for April'). Works as designed but could surprise users who think 'April was 50, May should default to 50 even without save'. Document or pre-seed on first PUT.

POST /api/payroll/lock body returns lock object including '_id' is excluded via projection {'_id':0} on existing, but new doc has 'lock' = doc which has insert_one side-effect adding _id to dict; pop('_id', None) guards it - OK.
PDF report endpoint hardcodes column widths; if pracownik names > ~50mm wide the cell wraps with default text style without ellipsis. Minor UX.
Frontend PayrollAdmin.js: confirm() native dialog used for lock/unlock - on iOS Safari this is sync but blocks page; consider replacing with shadcn Dialog for consistent UX.
test_iter30_thumbnails.py imports backend internal module 'image_utils' which is not in PYTHONPATH when running pytest from /app root - pre-existing infra bug, not from iter34.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 flows: login, tab nav, lock click, banner show, btn text flip, NumCell disabled+opacity, Add-employee disabled, unlock flip back, audit modal opens, Tools tab clean)

seed_data_creation: Created two TEST_iter34_* employees per pytest module run, cleaned up via fixture teardown. Lock/audit/PDF months used: 2025-03/04, 2024-12, 2025-01, 2027-06, 2027-07, 2027-08 to avoid collision with prior iteration data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Selectors verified live: [data-testid=payroll-lock-toggle], [data-testid=payroll-locked-banner], [data-testid=payroll-pdf-report], [data-testid^=payroll-audit-{eid}] (18 rendered), [data-testid=payroll-audit-modal], [data-testid=payroll-add-employee], NumCell inputs get class 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed' when locked. Backend endpoints: GET /api/payroll returns {locked, lock_info, rows[].defaulted_from_prev, totals}. PUT /api/payroll/{eid} returns 423 when locked. POST /api/payroll/lock idempotent (200 'Juz zamkniety'). POST /api/payroll/unlock returns 400 if not locked. GET /api/payroll/{eid}/audit returns entries sorted by changed_at desc. POST /api/payroll/pdf/report -> application/pdf >10KB. iter30 pre-existing failure remains; ignore.
